# Prime lenses versus zooms

Expose for the highlights on digital sensors, since clipped highlights cannot be recovered. A fast prime lens gathers more light and forces you to move your feet to frame the shot. In street photography, a smile and a nod after the shot usually turns a stranger into a willing subject. Leading lines pull the eye through the frame toward the subject. White balance sets the colour of neutral grey; shoot RAW and fix it later if unsure.

## Steps

- Expose for the highlights on digital sensors, since clipped highlights cannot be recovered.
- White balance sets the colour of neutral grey; shoot RAW and fix it later if unsure.
- A polarising filter removes glare from water and deepens a blue sky.
- Leading lines pull the eye through the frame toward the subject.
- RAW files keep more highlight and shadow detail than JPEG, which gives room in editing.
